visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short black hair and pigtails stands on a wooden floor, looking slightly dazed and confused. She is wearing a cream-colored sleeveless dress with colorful embroidered dots. Behind her, a wooden rocking horse and some cardboard boxes are visible in a brightly lit indoor living room. (2) The camera pans to a large white plastic and black metal wire cat cage. A child is seen crawling inside the cage on an upper platform. The girl inside the cage looks curious as she peers through the bars. An adult's hand briefly enters the frame to interact with the cage door. (3) The girl is now sitting inside the lower section of the cat cage, which contains a litter box. She steps into the tan-colored cat litter with her bare feet and begins to touch the grains with her hands. Her facial expression is one of fascination and discovery. Adult hands reach in to gently pull her away from the sand. (4) A male adult picks the girl up from the cage; she is wearing different clothes now, a white t-shirt with a large red tomato graphic and patterned blue/orange shorts. They are moving toward a bathroom. The girl looks reluctant but calm as she is carried. (5) The scene shifts to a bathroom with light wood-patterned tiles. The girl stands holding two green plastic toy scoops. Her bare feet are visibly covered in white cat litter grains. She looks up at the camera while an adult points at her sandy feet. (6) Close-up on the girl's feet on the bathroom floor, showing the high density of white litter clinging to her skin. The background shows a white bathtub and various toiletries. (7) An outro animation appears on a solid pink background, showing a cartoon version of the girl sitting cross-legged, with the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' displayed below.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A light, bouncy acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts. A woman’s high-pitched, playful voice asks where 'Popo' is. The audio is clear with low room tone. (2) The female voice expresses surprise as she realizes the child is in the cat cage. A toddler's soft, high-pitched voice repeats words like 'Good'. The BGM continues steadily. (3) Sounds of soft rustling from the cat litter can be heard. The woman's voice becomes more animated and rhythmic, teasing the child about not being a cat. Laughter is audible in the background. (4) A male voice enters, speaking with a gentle, slightly authoritative tone as the child is moved. The BGM remains upbeat. (5) Transition to the bathroom; the female voice continues speaking, now with a mock-serious tone about the sand on the child's feet. The toddler makes small vocalizations. (6) High-pitched cartoon-style sound effects emphasize the child's sandy feet. The woman's voice rises in excitement while discussing going to the park. (7) The BGM swells slightly for the outro, ending with a short, clean melodic resolution.
